title: Romantic Getaway to Vermont: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Vermont. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Vermont sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
Vermont offers a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation. If you are planning a romantic getaway to Vermont, you will find endless opportunities to create unforgettable memories.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Vermont
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Vermont](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1603331651359-86dd9d0a92c2?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of USA's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Villa rentals offer privacy and space for couples who want to create their own romantic retreat in Vermont.
